info.title: EGroupware Mail REST API
info.description: REST API for the EGroupware Mail application. Supports sending mail, launching compose windows, viewing EML files, uploading attachments, and managing vacation notices. Also includes (tag 'Mail Folders/Emails (JMAP-lite)') a read-only set of endpoints to list folders and emails, and download attachments or the raw .eml message, using field names modeled on JMAP's Mailbox/Email objects - not a full JMAP implementation, see doc/ai/projects/mail-rest-jmap-lite.md.

servers.description: Production server (replace with your EGroupware URL)

get.description: Returns a list of mail accounts (identities/signatures) available to the authenticated user.

post.description: Sends an email using the default or specified mail identity.

get.description: Returns the full configuration of a specific mail account by its ID. Passwords are masked for security.

post.summary: Send mail for a specific identity
post.description: Sends an email using the specified mail identity (by ID).

patch.description: Updates specific fields of a mail account. Requires appropriate permissions (admin or editable account). Only provided fields are modified.

post.summary: Launch compose window for a specific identity
post.description: Launches an interactive compose window for the specified mail identity.
Uploads a file to be used as an attachment for sending or composing mail.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Name of the file to upload

parameters.name: Content-Type
parameters.description: Content type of the file being uploaded

parameters.name: X-No-Location
parameters.description: If true, suppresses the Location header in the response

post.description: Uploads an EML file to be viewed in the Drafts folder. The user can then reply, forward, or download attachments.

post.summary: View an EML file for a specific identity
post.description: Uploads an EML file to be viewed in the Drafts folder of the specified mail identity.

get.description: Retrieves the current vacation message/handling settings for the default mail identity.

post.description: Enables or disables vacation message or forwarding for the default mail identity.

get.summary: Get vacation settings for a specific identity
get.description: Retrieves the current vacation message/handling settings for the specified mail identity.

200.description: Current vacation settings for the specified identity

post.summary: Set vacation message/forwarding for a specific identity
post.description: Enables or disables vacation message or forwarding for the specified mail identity.

get.summary: List folders (mailboxes) for the default identity
get.description: Proxies the account's real JMAP session (Http for Stalwart, or the local JmapShim for plain-IMAP accounts) - not a hand-picked field subset. See doc/ai/projects/mail-rest-jmap-lite.md.

get.summary: List folders (mailboxes) for a specific identity
get.description: Same as GET /mail/folders, for the specified mail identity. See doc/ai/projects/mail-rest-jmap-lite.md.
Returns one Mailbox object by id, for the default identity, proxied from the account's JMAP session. See doc/ai/projects/mail-rest-jmap-lite.md.

get.summary: Get a single folder for a specific identity
get.description: Same as GET /mail/folders/{folderId}, for the specified mail identity. See doc/ai/projects/mail-rest-jmap-lite.md.
Proxies the account's real JMAP session's Email/query + Email/get - not a hand-picked field subset. See doc/ai/projects/mail-rest-jmap-lite.md.

get.summary: List emails in a folder for a specific identity
get.description: Same as GET /mail/folders/{folderId}/emails, for the specified mail identity. See doc/ai/projects/mail-rest-jmap-lite.md.

Returns one Email object, proxied from the account's JMAP session - genuine JMAP body shape (bodyStructure/bodyValues by partId) when body properties are requested, not a flattened simplification. See doc/ai/projects/mail-rest-jmap-lite.md.

get.summary: Get a single email for a specific identity
get.description: Same as GET /mail/folders/{folderId}/emails/{emailId}, for the specified mail identity. See doc/ai/projects/mail-rest-jmap-lite.md.

get.summary: Download attachment content, or the raw .eml message
get.description: Downloads raw bytes by blobId, via a backend-uniform blob fetch (AttachmentJmap::fetchBlobBytes()). blobId can be one of an email's attachments[] entries, OR the email's own top-level blobId (RFC 8621 - the whole raw message) - there is no separate 'download raw .eml' endpoint, this one covers both, returning Content-Type: message/rfc822 and a '<subject>.eml' filename for the latter. folderId/emailId are for discoverability/consistency only - the fetch itself only needs the account and blobId. See doc/ai/projects/mail-rest-jmap-lite.md.

get.summary: Download attachment content for a specific identity
get.description: Same as GET /mail/folders/{folderId}/emails/{emailId}/attachments/{blobId}, for the specified mail identity. See doc/ai/projects/mail-rest-jmap-lite.md.

basicAuth.description: Basic authentication with username and password or token

folderId.name: folderId
folderId.description: Opaque folder id, as returned by GET /mail/folders - never construct or parse this value, always echo one previously returned by this API. Alternatively, a human-readable literal folder name/path is also accepted here: a single top-level folder directly (e.g. 'INBOX'), or a deeper one '::'-joined (e.g. 'INBOX::Sent' for INBOX/Sent, since a literal '/' can't appear inside one URL path segment) - resolved to the real folder internally. INBOX is matched case-insensitively as the first path segment only (RFC 3501 §5.1); any other segment is an ordinary, case-sensitive folder name. This is a purely additive alternative - the real id keeps working unchanged.

emailId.name: emailId
emailId.description: Opaque email id, as returned by GET /mail/folders/{folderId}/emails. Never construct or parse this value - always echo one previously returned by this API.

blobId.name: blobId
blobId.description: Opaque attachment blob id, as found in an Email object's attachments[].blobId. Never construct or parse this value - always echo one previously returned by this API.

properties.name: properties
properties.description: Comma-separated list of JMAP properties to return, forwarded verbatim to the underlying Mailbox/get or Email/get call (this API does not maintain its own fixed field subset). Omit for a backend-dependent default set of standard properties.

subscribedOnly.name: subscribedOnly
subscribedOnly.description: Only list subscribed folders (default true), or all folders

sort.name: sort
sort.description: Sort order, e.g. 'receivedAt desc' (default) or 'receivedAt asc'

responses.description: Map of mail account paths to their display names (e.g., '/ralf/mail/1': 'Ralf Becker <ralf@example.org>')

MailAccount.description: Full mail account configuration returned by GET /mail/{id}. Passwords are masked for security.

accImapLogintype.description: Login type for IMAP (e.g., '' (Username specified for all), 'standard' (username from account), 'vmailmgr' (username@domainname), 'uidNumber' (UserId@domain eg. u1234@domain), 'email' (EMail-address from account, 'domain/username' (Exchange: domain/username)

accUserEditable.description: Whether the user can edit this account

accountStatus.description: True if the account is active/enabled

MailAccountPatch.description: Partial update object for PATCH /mail/{id}. Only provided fields are modified. Read-only fields (e.g., passwords, IDs) will be ignored.

accImapLogintype.description: Login type for IMAP (e.g., '' (Username specified for all), 'standard' (username from account), 'vmailmgr' (username@domainname), 'uidNumber' (UserId@domain eg. u1234@domain), 'email' (EMail-address from account, 'domain/username' (Exchange: domain/username)

accUserEditable.description: Whether the user can edit this account

to.description: Array of RFC882 email addresses (e.g., ['info@egroupware.org', 'Ralf Becker <rb@egroupware.org>'])

body.description: Plain text body of the email

replyEml.description: String returned from an uploaded EML file to reply to

attachments.description: Array of attachment paths or tokens (e.g., ['/mail/attachments/<token>', '/home/<user>/<filename>'])

shareExpiration.description: Expiration date for shares (e.g., 'yyyy-mm-dd' or '+2days'). Default: not accessed in 100 days (EPL only)

sharePassword.description: Password required to access the share (EPL only)

folder.description: Folder to store the sent mail (default: Sent folder)

priority.description: Priority of the email (1: high, 3: normal, 5: low)

text.description: Vacation notice text (can contain $$start$$ and $$end$$ placeholders)

forwards.description: Array of RFC882 email addresses to forward mail to

addresses.description: Array of RFC882 email addresses to apply vacation settings to (default: primary email only)

days.description: Number of days after which a sender receives the vacation message again

Mailbox.description: Proxied from the account's real JMAP session (Http for Stalwart, JmapShim for plain IMAP) - not a hand-picked field subset; additional properties beyond the ones listed here may be present or absent depending on backend and the `properties` query parameter. id/parentId are the session's own ids (real JMAP ids for Stalwart, base64(folder path) for the shim) - always treat as opaque. myRights/totalThreads/unreadThreads are only present for a Stalwart-backed (real JMAP) account; hasChildren/aclCapable/isSelectable are shim-only extras with no RFC 8621 counterpart. path/isSelectable are always present regardless of the `properties` query parameter, same as id.

name.description: Display name of just this folder (not the full path)

path.description: Human-readable, '/'-joined canonical folder path (e.g. 'INBOX/Sent') - the display-side counterpart of the '::'-joined literal-path folderId syntax also accepted by the folderId path parameter (e.g. 'INBOX::Sent'). Always present, not affected by the `properties` query parameter.

parentId.description: Id of the parent folder, or null for a top-level folder

role.description: Best-effort role, derived from the account's configured special folders

isSelectable.description: false only for the shim's synthetic IMAP shared/other-users namespace-root pseudo-folder ('user'/'shared') - a real listing entry, but never a real, fetchable mailbox itself (derived from the real IMAP \Noselect LIST attribute). Always true for a Stalwart/real-JMAP account, which has no namespace-root concept at all.

MailboxListResponse.description: Response envelope for the JMAP-lite folders/emails endpoints.

responses.description: Map of resource path (e.g. '/mail/folders/<folderId>') to Mailbox object

EmailListItem.description: Proxied from the account's real JMAP session's Email/get - default list-view properties shown here, but the full set returned is controlled by the `properties` query parameter, same as real JMAP. id is the session's own id (real JMAP id for Stalwart, IMAP UID for the shim) - always treat as opaque.

mailboxIds.description: Map of folder id -> true. Usually a single entry; may have more than one for a backend where a message can live in multiple mailboxes.

keywords.description: JMAP keyword map, e.g. {"$seen": true, "$flagged": true}, translated from IMAP flags

preview.description: Short plain-text snippet - only present when requested via the properties query parameter

threadId.description: Only present when requested via the properties query parameter - supported on both backends

EmailListResponse.description: Response envelope for the JMAP-lite folders/emails endpoints.

responses.description: Map of resource path (e.g. '/mail/folders/<folderId>/emails/<emailId>') to Email list-view object

position.description: Offset of the first returned email

total.description: Total number of emails matching the query, ignoring position/limit

EmailAttachment.description: Attachment metadata; the blobId downloads the actual content via GET .../emails/{emailId}/attachments/{blobId}.

blobId.description: Opaque blob id - pass to the attachment-download endpoint

cid.description: Content-ID, for inline-referenced attachments (e.g. images referenced from htmlBody via cid:)

Email.description: Full single-resource Email object: EmailListItem fields plus genuine JMAP body fields (proxied as-is, not flattened) when requested via properties.

blobId.description: Opaque blob id of the WHOLE raw RFC 5322 message (RFC 8621 §4.1.1) - only present when requested via properties (included by default for GET .../emails/{emailId}). Download it via GET .../attachments/{blobId} for the raw .eml - there is no separate 'download raw' endpoint.

bodyStructure.description: JMAP EmailBodyPart tree (RFC 8621 §4.1.4) - only present when requested via properties

textBody.description: JMAP EmailBodyPart references into bodyValues - only present when requested via properties

htmlBody.description: JMAP EmailBodyPart references into bodyValues - only present when requested via properties; inline cid: references are left unrewritten

bodyValues.description: Map of partId -> {value, isTruncated, isEncodingProblem} (RFC 8621 §4.1.4) - only present when requested via properties

attachments.description: Only present when requested via properties
